items.title: test(agents): own session-store fixture cleanup
items.summary: test(agents): own session-store fixture cleanup Join asynchronous database drainage before resetting fixture trust and removing temporary files. Reuse createFixtureLifetime to retain files and resource custody when cleanup cannot be verified. Await the existing maintenance-completion signal instead of polling rows against a fixed five-second deadline. Preserve every row assertion. No production runtime changes. On macOS with Node 24.21.0 and fs-safe 0.18.0, all 103 owner cases passed on 23eb2a6f in 187.971 s wall, including fresh worker preparation. The unchanged patch also passed all 21 selected checks and independent P2 review on 13d421c; intervening runtime/schema changes were inspected and covered by the new owner run. Refs #154828

items.title: fix: group chats stall when historyLimit is the JSON integer maximum …
items.summary: fix: group chats stall when historyLimit is the JSON integer maximum (#154305) * fix: group chats stall when historyLimit is the JSON integer maximum JSON schema allows 9007199254740991, which channels treated as an unbounded chat window and stuffed into the model prompt. Treat that sentinel as unset, cap prompt windows, and have doctor strip it. * fix: preserve bounded history settings through Doctor Share one private numeric history policy without expanding the public SDK. Preserve inherited and explicit-zero settings during Telegram repair, document the ceiling, and retain shipped compatibility exports. Co-authored-by: VACInc * fix: keep history proof behind the Doctor boundary Exercise Telegram repair through the existing scoped production dispatcher rather than a forbidden extension import. Regenerate bundled channel metadata so the verified observed-message and transcript guidance reaches consumers. Preserve all runtime behavior and boundary guards. Co-authored-by: VACInc * test: observe durable approval and recovery completion Reuse the scoped fixture-owner repair published in PR #153829 at d8d7c540cdd62f0fb15017a31e703fe82f146a51. Observe real RPC acceptance, approval publication, committed session state, and queued admission; join operations before cleanup. Preserve all authority, cancellation, durable-state, and call-count assertions without changing production behavior or timeouts. Co-authored-by: VACInc * test: await exec approval acceptance before assertions Reuse the existing fixture owner published in PR #153829 at d8d7c540cdd62f0fb15017a31e703fe82f146a51. Wait for real acceptance instead of short pending-record and broadcast polling, preserve all sanitization, provenance, and cancellation assertions, and join pending requests before database cleanup. No production or timeout change. Co-authored-by: VACInc * test: prepare approval worker before identity deadlines Use the existing prepared approval fixture before the unchanged two-second registration deadline starts. Preserve revoked-generation rejection and replacement-generation allow-once assertions. Controlled first-owner latency reproduces the old expired-but-authorized pending-card failure; identical latency before record creation passes. Diagnostic instrumentation is not retained. Co-authored-by: VACInc --------- Co-authored-by: VACInc Co-authored-by: roboclaw-bot
